title: Goal-Oriented Sequential Bayesian Experimental Design for Causal Learning
abstract: arXiv:2507.07359v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present GO-CBED, a goal-oriented Bayesian framework for sequential causal experimental design. Unlike conventional approaches that select interventions aimed at inferring the full causal model, GO-CBED directly maximizes the expected information gain (EIG) on user-specified causal quantities of interest, enabling more targeted and efficient experimentation. The framework is both non-myopic, optimizing over entire intervention sequences, and goal-oriented, targeting only model aspects relevant to the causal query. To address the intractability of exact EIG computation, we introduce a variational lower bound estimator, optimized jointly through a transformer-based policy network and normalizing flow-based variational posteriors. The resulting policy enables real-time decision-making via an amortized network. translated_title: 面向目标的因果学习序贯贝叶斯实验设计
translated_abstract: 我们提出了GO-CBED，一个面向目标的序贯因果实验设计贝叶斯框架。与旨在通过选择干预来推断完整因果模型的传统方法不同，GO-CBED直接最大化用户指定的目标因果量上的期望信息增益（EIG），从而实现更有针对性、更高效的实验。该框架既具有非短视性（对整个干预序列进行优化），又具有面向目标性（仅关注与因果查询相关的模型方面）。为解决精确EIG计算的难解性问题，我们引入了一个变分下界估计器，通过基于Transformer的策略网络和基于归一化流的变分后验进行联合优化。由此得到的策略可通过摊销网络实现实时决策。我们证明，GO-CBED在多种因果推理与因果发现任务中始终优于现有基线方法。
tldr: GO-CBED是一个面向目标的贝叶斯序贯因果实验设计框架，通过变分下界估计与Transformer策略网络直接最大化用户指定因果量的期望信息增益，实现非短视且实时的干预决策，在因果推理与发现任务中优于现有基线。
en_tdlr: GO-CBED is a goal-oriented Bayesian framework for sequential causal experimental design that maximizes expected information gain on user-specified causal quantities via variational lower bound estimation with a transformer-based policy network, enabling non-myopic, real-time intervention decisions that outperform existing baselines in causal reasoning and discovery tasks.
